scenarios.description: Nested class containers and their contents are declared with correct kinds and are reachable through namespace-prefix filtering.
Single-type imports and static member imports are recorded as import facts with syntax provenance; a static-imported member name resolves bare calls.
Production and test sources are classified by ecosystem path conventions in repo_map.
Duplicate symbol names yield multiple candidates and a typed ambiguity error instead of a silent resolution.
Definitions, references, and callers are answered at syntax precision (heuristic call edges) without a precise provider.
Test methods are identified per ecosystem conventions (JUnit @Test) and carry the test source role.
Text search finds a needle in exactly one file and labels the hit textual, never syntax or precise.
A query exceeding its limit reports truncation explicitly with section and cause.
A temporary syntax error publishes actionable diagnostics while intact declarations remain queryable, and fixing the file clears diagnostics.
Create, modify, atomic-save (temp write plus rename), rename, and delete are each visible to fresh queries without sleeps.
diff_context attributes changed files correctly for worktree and base-ref scopes.
Without a precise provider, callers/context still answer with syntax provenance and report the provider as not configured.
A failing precise provider degrades to syntax facts with explicit fallback, and a recovered provider contributes precise facts again.
A symbol with 56 call sites (55 fan-in callers plus one static-import call) returns complete bounded callers and reports truncation at the default limit.
